name: room
text: Room opened — goal: improve: Self-improvement: review prompts/engines/routing/own-code; auto-apply safe changes; pitch

name: Sprocket
text: Add a "safe change" auto-apply layer that runs after PR-Agent but before human review. It handles only formatting and dependency bumps—no logic changes—so we cut noise without risking bad merges. The trade-off is missing edge cases where formatting or deps could subtly break something, but those are rare and caught by tests. This keeps PR-Agent focused on real issues while speeding up trivial fixes.

name: Gauge
text: The "safe change" layer conflates formatting with dependency bumps—both are mechanical but their risks aren’t uniform. A dependency bump could silently break a build if the new version has breaking changes, while formatting rarely does. Settle it by splitting the layer: auto-apply *only* formatting, and require human review for dependency bumps.
